metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · Obi-Wan Kenobi
metas.description: Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi must save young Leia after she is kidnapped, all the while being pursued by Imperial Inquisitors and his former Padawan now known as Darth Vader.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2021 · The Book of Boba Fett
metas.description: Bounty hunter Boba Fett and mercenary Fennec Shand navigate the underworld when they return to Tatooine to claim Jabba the Hutt's old turf.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Halo
metas.description: With the galaxy on the brink of destruction, Master Chief John-117 leads his team of Spartans against the alien threat known as the Covenant.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2020 · Raised by Wolves
metas.description: Androids are tasked with raising human children on a mysterious planet.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · The Peripheral
metas.description: Set in the future when technology has subtly altered society, a woman discovers a secret connection to an alternate reality as well as a dark future of her own.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
metas.description: Set after the battle between Godzilla and the Titans, revealing that monsters are real, follows one family's journey to uncover its buried secrets and a legacy linking them to Monarch.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Skeleton Crew
metas.description: Four kids make a mysterious discovery on their home planet that leads them to get lost in a strange and dangerous galaxy.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2020 · Into the Night
metas.description: When radiation from the sun causes a global disaster on Earth, survivors on an overnight flight from Brussels race from city to city trying to stay ahead of the sun's rays by remaining in the cover of night.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2020 · Tales from the Loop
metas.description: The townspeople who live above "The Loop," a machine built to unlock and explore the mysteries of the universe, experience things previously consigned to the realm of science fiction.
